protocol.capacity_rule: one fixed absolute memory.max: max reference initial + 620MiB, round up 64MiB
protocol.prediction: rolling measured reference, refreshed every 0.5s with actual current headroom; not a learned model

protocol.compression: zswap Y; actual compressed pages must be observed
protocol.runtime_protection: per-app reference-adjusted refault/PSI plus foreground response; immutable budgets
protocol.cold: scripted old images/rows/canvases, allowable quantity bounded by measured safe levels
protocol.caveat: one off/on pair per scenario, four-app test domain, no statistical optimum claim

trials.safety_floor: native calibration evidence required for formal execution
trials.pressure_scope: one isolated cgroup containing four native applications; not physical-machine exhaustion

cold_preset.gimp: old-image layers 3..15 not touched before revisit
cold_preset.libreoffice: old rows 100..79999 not read before revisit
cold_preset.firefox: old canvas 1..7 not read before revisit
